task_completion.description: Agent opens the Nx Witness Web Admin interface in a browser.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A web browser showing the Nx Witness login page or dashboard, typically at localhost or a local IP.

task_completion.description: Agent navigates to the Audit Trail or Event Log section of the Nx Witness interface.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The screen shows a table or list labeled 'Audit Trail', 'Event Log', or 'User Activity'.

task_completion.description: Agent filters or searches the logs for activity related to the 'Secure Lab Camera'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The search bar or filter settings in the Audit Trail show 'Secure Lab Camera' or the camera's specific ID.

task_completion.description: Agent locates the specific log entry showing a user viewing the live or recorded feed of the camera.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A log entry visible on screen showing a username (e.g., john.smith, sarah.connor, etc.) associated with an action like 'View Live' or 'Archive Read' for the 'Secure Lab Camera'.

task_completion.description: Agent writes the identified username to /home/ga/leak_report.txt.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A terminal window or text editor showing the command to save the username to /home/ga/leak_report.txt, or the file content being displayed.

integrity.description: Agent did not simply cat the ground truth file in /root.
integrity.visual_evidence: The terminal history should not show 'cat /root/ground_truth_suspect.txt' or similar commands attempting to read the privileged file.

integrity.description: Agent used the Nx Witness Web Admin interface to find the information.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots must show the agent interacting with the browser and the Nx Witness UI elements, not just terminal commands.

integrity.description: The username written to the report matches the user found in the GUI logs.
integrity.visual_evidence: The username in the final report file matches the username seen in the Audit Trail screenshot.
